remarksWeb: 1. Other than Rajkumari Yabaji (Promote Group) none of the promoter group mentioned in Individual and Any other specified category under table II of SHP holds any share in the Company and hence their shareholding is NIL.  2. Out of the total issued capital of 18,21,38,576 equity shares, 60,974 equity shares were allotted on June 23, 2026 under Company ESOP Schemes and the corporate action in respect of the said allotment was completed on June 30, 2026.   The Company received listing approval from the Stock Exchanges on June 30, 2026, stating that trading would be effective from July 1, 2026.   Since on June 30, 2026 the shares were not listed therefore it was not shown in RTA report . Accordingly, there is difference of 60,974 equity shares in equity shares held in dematerialised form (Column H).  3. ZZ Logistics Solutions Private Limited (ZZLSPL), a non-material wholly owned subsidiary of BlackBuck Limited, was struck off by the MCA on its own application and ceased to be a subsidiary w.e.f. May 11, 2026; accordingly, it has been removed from the promoter group in the shareholding pattern for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
